item.title: Performance Max will spend your budget on your competitors
item.description: A routine search term audit found a Performance Max campaign returning 19 cents on the euro, most of it spent on rival brand names. How it happens, and the fix.
item.dc:creator: Mafer Chang

item.title: llms.txt will not get you cited by AI
item.description: Two studies covering 300,000 domains and 137,000 sites found no citation lift from llms.txt. What the evidence says, and where to spend that hour instead.
item.dc:creator: Mafer Chang
